_meta.description: The zeek stream (logs-dxdfir.zeek-*): the logs-*-* base + logs-dxdfir@settings + the Zeek network-log fields (the per-protocol columns the Malcolm dashboards read); kept off every other stream so bare names like user/tls/severity do not collide with the ECS user / Suricata tls / numeric severity those streams carry. Priority 500 — higher than the logs-dxdfir.*-* fallback (200) — so this stream composes only this lane's model(s), not every lane's, and bare field names stay contained to the stream that uses them.
